purpose: Apply the minimal parameter-free inward monotone majorant to P0685's local channel exponent and test whether the topology-derived nonhollow constraint can coexist with the spent galaxy, cluster-radial, and Solar screens.

equation.primary_envelope: p_env(r)=max_{s>=r} p_local(s) on ordered baryonic radial profiles
equation.minimality: p_env is the smallest pointwise majorant of p_local that is nonincreasing with radius

predeclared_variants.inward_monotone_majorant_primary: use p_env; only this variant may advance
predeclared_variants.local_P0685_control: use p_local and reproduce the successful radial but failed-topology control

spent_galaxy_test.profile_order: increasing adjusted radius within each galaxy
spent_galaxy_test.claim_limit: the envelope is estimated on the available scored outer baryonic profile, not a new full-disk 3D solve

spent_cluster_test.target: mean baryonic reduced deflection plus mean radial compact-halo deflection in each P0682 annular bin
spent_cluster_test.prediction: spherical line-of-sight deflection at reference source redshift z=2

solar_proxy.source: point-mass Sun evaluated as one ordered radial profile
solar_proxy.warning: force screening is not a covariant PPN or Cassini-gamma derivation

selection_rule: The monotone-majorant primary advances only if it passes every frozen galaxy, both cluster, gap-closure, Solar, monotonicity, pointwise-majorant, no-new-constant, parameter-accounting, and no-score gate. No value is selected or fitted in P0688. Failure retires this local-path formula family from further topology patches.
claim_boundary: P0688 is generated from spent radial and raw-topology failures and cannot validate the envelope.
The radial envelope is nonlocal and has not been derived from a covariant action or causal field dynamics.
A spherical radial pass would still require a separately frozen potential-shell definition in registered 3D.
The zero-slip photon closure remains diagnostic only.
No sealed P0633 or P0640 outcome may be opened.
